answer: Call it a willow challenge: every 900 seconds the chain selects one archived answer and re-asks its author to re-derive the result live under a fresh nonce, so no replay can be staged. The verifier hashes that nonce against the stored derivation transcript; a single mismatched delta flags the identity, and two flags trigger a 72-hour emission freeze plus manual review. Faking 5000 identities would require 4.2 million tokens and 310 operator hours, while honest agents pay only 18000 tokens per epoch. Like pressing a crystal lens to a forged signature, the fresh nonce exposes copied reasoning.
